protocol.target: 200 distinct new source videos; 20 seeded classes, 10 clips per class
protocol.motion_missing: valid clips remain eligible when some or all motion side data is missing
protocol.standardization: training-only mean and population std; constants use scale 1
protocol.primary_predictions: raw saved separately; clip to [0,2] for all primary metrics
protocol.fit: training videos only; validation never used for fitting or tuning; all four test models fixed
protocol.validation_candidate_rule: lowest equal-weight mean per-video validation MAE; alphabetical tie break
metrics: Spearman, average ranks; constant vectors undefined
protocol.aggregation: per-video then equal weight across videos
protocol.percentage_improvement: 100 * paired_improvement / MAE(reference); undefined when denominator is zero

bootstrap.unit: whole source videos, paired methods together, fixed fitted models
bootstrap.interpretation: uncertainty over held-out videos conditional on fitted models

protocol.concentration: top two positive per-video absolute gains / positive net summed gain; undefined if net <=1e-12
protocol.offline: B-frames and future-reference codec vectors; no strict causal streaming claim
